string.text: The employer... is the Commander? In that case... how about I give you a discount now, and we put together a long-term employment contract?
Well well, if it isn't Stechkin!
Commander, you're back? I thought I had the day off today...
How is it working under Nagant?
Although Nagant can be naggy, but she does it for the sake of us juniors. Oh, you mean her "combat experience"? You can take that with a grain of salt...
Extra work? Sure thing, but remember to pay for my overtime!
Ok Ksenia, enough for now. Please head back to base.
